root.label: ProPublica North Carolina private school notice

events.label: ProPublica North Carolina private school notice

slots.name: inspection score
slots.sentence: We uploaded the new report, along with the brewery’s current food establishment inspection (on which it received a 99, an excellent score, we felt, for a school).

slots.name: new private schools
slots.sentence: Then, we watched a four-minute, 39-second video explaining how to file the required notice of intent.

slots.name: application status
slots.sentence: The screen flashed a confirmation. “Thank you. We have received your request to open a private school.”

slots.name: count of new private schools
slots.sentence: We hoped to join the at least 169 other new private schools that have opened in North Carolina since the 2021-22 school year, which marked the start of a series of expansions to the state’s publicly funded vouchers for private school tuition.
